from pathlib import Path
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/bug72399.phpt","function":"<global>","line":8,"var":"$var5","code":"$var5 = mb_ereg_search_init(\"\",\"2\");","note":"The search API stores a compiled regex object in mbstring globals, and later calls can reuse or free that state."},
{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/bug72399.phpt","function":"<global>","line":9,"var":"$var6","code":"$var6 = mb_eregi_replace(\"2\",\"\",\"\");","note":"A second mbregex API call runs after search initialization, exercising the shared search_re state across APIs."},
{"step":3,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/bug72399.phpt","function":"<global>","line":10,"var":"$var13","code":"$var13 = mb_ereg_search_pos();","note":"The follow-up search-position query touches the shared search state after prior regex operations, matching the historical UAF bug shape."},
{"step":4,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_init)","line":1264,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"MBREX(search_re) = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, option, MBREX(current_mbctype), syntax);","note":"The pattern is compiled and stored in the global search_re slot, which is later reused by other mbregex functions."},
{"step":5,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_init)","line":1280,"var":"MBREX(search_str)","code":"ZVAL_STR_COPY(&MBREX(search_str), arg_str);","note":"The subject string is also stored globally, so later search operations operate on shared mutable regex state."},
{"step":6,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_pos)","line":0,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_search_exec(INTERNAL_FUNCTION_PARAM_PASSTHRU, 1);","note":"Search-position queries reuse the same global search_re and search_str, so stale or freed regex state can be dereferenced here."},
{"step":7,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_search_exec","line":1434,"var":"MBREX(search_regs)","code":"if (MBREX(search_regs)) { onig_region_free(MBREX(search_regs), 1); }","note":"The search region is explicitly freed before allocating a new one, showing the code's reliance on careful lifetime management."},
{"step":8,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_search_exec","line":1436,"var":"MBREX(search_regs)","code":"MBREX(search_regs) = onig_region_new();","note":"A fresh region is allocated for the next search, but the regex object itself remains shared in the global state."},
{"step":9,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_search_exec","line":1438,"var":"err","code":"err = _php_mb_onig_search(MBREX(search_re), str, str + len, str + pos, str  + len, MBREX(search_regs), 0);","note":"The shared regex object is executed again; if prior operations invalidated it, this is the sink where a use-after-free would occur."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('trace updated')
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/candidate_trace.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json
